descriptions.w3d_d25b_inventory_reset_8008b80c: Inventory weapon slots reset: formats sixteen and then four resource names into a string (0x8020c510, formats 0x8037de84 and 0x8037de98), loads each inventory object through one handle (0x800fc1b0, 0x80341584, 0x80179598) and clears its counters at +20 and +24 to +64.
